content: The understanding of NMT models has been approached primarily from two complementary perspectives. The first thread of work aims to understand the importance of representations by analyzing the linguistic information embedded in representation vectors BIBREF3, BIBREF4 or hidden units BIBREF5, BIBREF6. Another direction focuses on understanding the importance of input words by interpreting the input-output behavior of NMT models. Previous work BIBREF7 treats NMT models as black-boxes and provides explanations that closely resemble the attention scores in NMT models. However, recent studies reveal that attention does not provide meaningful explanations since the relationship between attention scores and model output is unclear BIBREF8.
